title: The Cue Lamp
audience: A 10-second KPOP grammar proof: one continuous cue-lamp line, one clean human cast, one stage that changes.
tone: warm, urgent, pop; a stage calling a name
logline: Every night the cue lamp calls one name; tonight it called Nova, but the wings were empty.

spine.obstacle: the name it calls is not there
spine.turn: the empty wings become the story
spine.button: the crowd waits for a star who never came

narration.text: Every night the cue lamp calls one name, tonight it called Nova, but the wings were empty and the crowd waited for a star who never came.
